title: [Mouse Without Borders] Disconnects due to disappearing cursor

judgment.rationale: The issue is explicitly duplicate-labeled and now includes a concrete tested fix attempt for the reported mouse-injection failure. Do not start a competing design.

The author says the commit has unit tests and that a pull request will follow when open-PR capacity allows.
judgment.recommended_action: Track the author's existing commit and its promised pull request; do not duplicate the fallback implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The author has a public, tested commit covering InputInjector mouse-move refusal and the resulting connection drop; the change is not yet represented by an upstream PR.

inferences: The reported disconnects are consistent with a single mouse-injection exception being treated as a fatal socket/package error.
The commit's fallback is a plausible fix attempt, but the upstream issue remains open until the patch is reviewed and merged.
